speaker: abel_garnish
text: The book is on my knee, Master Will. The plot is on the nail. The yard is cold, and the book is open.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The gown first, and the song. We do not begin at the end.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: It is on me, sir. The sleeves are long. I can lift a hand and still have the wrist.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Walk, then. Thou art the Princess, not a boy showing a tailor's work.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: The hem knows the yard better than I do. I only have to follow it.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: You could wear sackcloth and still be heard, Nick. The blue is honest. Do not thank it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Fifty shillings of it is still on the Cheapside book. He may move in it. It is not paid.

speaker: will_kemp
text: A boy's blue, and my interest still a blank. I am here for the song, and for that I can be quiet. You have asked it often enough.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The song is Sam's. Stand out of his light, Will.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Sam. Here. Four notes and a breath. Forget the yard.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: I have the notes, sir. Where do I stand?

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Sing it on the breath, Sam, not on the word. The word will come along.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: I had the place and I lost it. The notes are still in my mouth. They did not go with the place.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Thou art left of Nick, by the nail. If thou lose the yard, look at his sleeve.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: Left of the nail. I will lose it again. I will not lose the note.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Again. On the breath. Do not hunt the word.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: There. That is the tune, and my feet are wrong, and I know which of the two I trust.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: You are left of my sleeve, Sam. Stay. I will not turn the gown to find you.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: He forgets the place and keeps the note. That is the right loss for this morning.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Entered, left of the Princess. If he comes in right, I shall not build him a stair.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: Left. The song does not need the board. My feet do. I have said it, and I still mean the note.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: A lost shoe I can cover with talk. A lost tune I cannot. Leave him the breath, Augustine.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Once more from the breath, Sam. Then we leave the song. The messenger is the rest of the morning.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Once more. Same breath. Do not add a word to help him.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: Both, this time. The note, and the nail. I trust the note if the nail moves.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: Sir, do I speak over him, or after the note has finished?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: After. Let it finish. Thou art not in a race with a song.

speaker: will_kemp
text: I was quiet. Abel will not write a silence, so the quiet is mine to remember, and his to ignore.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: I write entrances, Master Kemp. I do not write a man's silence as a line. The column beside you is still open.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Keep it open. Thursday is the first time a yard hears this. Today the gown walks, and the song lands.
